_note: Declared cadence of every scheduled pipeline in this repo. .github/scripts/check_pipeline_heartbeat.py fails the run when a workflow has not been started by its scheduler (or by a human, via workflow_dispatch) inside its expected_max_silence_minutes window. Add an entry when you add a schedule: trigger - backend/tests/unit/scripts/test_check_pipeline_heartbeat.py fails if this list and the workflow tree disagree.
_window_rule: expected_max_silence_minutes is roughly two cron intervals plus an hour of slack, so one late or skipped tick does not alert. Weekly jobs get eight days for the same reason (a single skipped Monday must not page anyone).
_excluded: pipeline-heartbeat.yml monitors this list and is deliberately not in it: a scheduler that has stopped firing cannot run the monitor that would report it, so self-monitoring can only ever raise a false alert on its own first run.
